lines: O whole garland, sequenceless, entered in self again and again,
ray-heaped within without end. Supreme, bliss to grasp, eager, noble — gracious to me be she; adorn the heart-path.
l4.sanskrit_cite: samagrām akṣālīṃ kramavirahitā sātmani muhur | prasannā me bhūyāt hṛdayapadavīṃ bhūṣayatu ca

verses.craft: Garland re-entered again-and-again; adorn-path prayed; recovered hemistich + bhūyāt correction per UNC.
